# ai-token-counter-api
Cloudflare Workers MCP server: ai-token-counter. REST + MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0). Live: api.lazy-mac.com/ai-token-counter

toolsPreview.name: count_tokens
toolsPreview.description: Count tokens for a text string or chat messages array for any supported AI model (GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, Llama).

toolsPreview.name: estimate_cost
toolsPreview.description: Estimate the cost of an AI API call given model and token counts or text. Returns input/output/total cost and optional monthly projection.

toolsPreview.name: get_model_pricing
toolsPreview.description: Get input/output pricing per 1M tokens for a specific AI model.

toolsPreview.name: list_models
toolsPreview.description: List all supported AI models with their pricing and context windows.
